verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists "Phone menus" alongside custom ring orders and call transfers, and the homepage claims it can route incoming calls to the right person, so the product names the IVR capability itself. The evidence is only a feature-list mention, with no documentation of how menus are built or how keypresses map to teams. Missing for 10: setup docs for menus and keypress options, explicit routing to teams or groups, plan or limit details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can build a phone menu (press 1 for sales) that routes callers to teams
